Passenger gender (1=Male, 2=Female), address, address2, and phone_country_code are optional but recommended.

item.description:
Update a supplier's configuration. Disabling a supplier will cause FlightSupplierFactory/HotelSupplierFactory to throw RuntimeException when attempting to use it.

Permission required: `supplier.configure`

Fields:
- is_enabled (boolean): Enable/disable supplier
- environment (string): sandbox | staging | production
- settings (object): Arbitrary key-value settings

All endpoints require `auth:sanctum` Bearer token and `api_monitor.view` permission.

Filter logs by endpoint path (uses partial matching).

item.description:
Get full details of a single observability log entry.

Permission required: `api_monitor.view`

item.name: Trace Request
item.description:
Get all log entries for a specific request ID, sorted chronologically.
This allows reconstructing the full lifecycle of a request.

Permission required: `api_monitor.view`

item.name: Daily Summary
item.description:
Get daily aggregated log statistics with breakdown by level (info, warning, error, critical, debug).

Permission required: `api_monitor.view`

item.name: Error Analytics
item.description:
Get error and critical log analytics: total count, breakdown by event/supplier/endpoint, and first_seen/last_seen timestamps.

Helps identify when a problem first appeared.

Permission required: `api_monitor.view`

item.name: Supplier Analytics
item.description:
Get observability metrics grouped by supplier: total logs, errors, warnings, criticals, and last activity.

Supplier-agnostic — works for all current and future suppliers.

Permission required: `api_monitor.view`

item.name: Event Analytics
item.description:
Get the most frequent events with their counts, error counts, warning counts, and last seen timestamp.

Permission required: `api_monitor.view`

item.name: Endpoint Analytics
item.description:
Get grouped metrics by endpoint: total logs, errors, warnings, and last seen.

Helps identify problematic API endpoints.

Permission required: `api_monitor.view`
